text_b92b4c0ae917: ALL KONJAC works with food manufacturers and international partners on ingredient, formulation and equipment enquiries. Share your destination market and project requirements to discuss a suitable scope.
text_1b507a605ced: ALL KONJAC provides konjac ingredients, konjac food equipment, drying-line engineering and hydrocolloid technology solutions for food manufacturers and international B2B partners.
text_7756995af4d3: Which ingredient products can I enquire about?
text_fae639310436: You can enquire about food-grade konjac powder, refined konjac powder and konjac gum. Share your application and required specification to discuss grade selection.
text_f520b3b52fc4: Can ingredients, formulation and equipment be discussed together?
text_f9b554a40074: Yes. A project enquiry can connect ingredient selection, formulation and sample development, process planning and equipment integration. The supply and service scope is agreed for each project.
text_6b4db64519bb: What information should I send to start a project?
text_cbdb75eafd21: For ingredients, send the application, specification, quantity and destination market. For equipment or drying lines, include the product or material, target output, process requirements and factory conditions.
text_342f5a9dfc22: How can I contact ALL KONJAC?
text_96392c48cde6: Email 583411495@qq.com or contact WhatsApp at +86 15637136906. The contact section also provides a WeChat QR code.

text_72a71b10cbcd: Konjac Powder & Konjac Gum Ingredients | ALL KONJAC
text_96d56bc0162c: Explore food-grade konjac powder, refined powder and konjac gum. Discuss ingredient grades, application requirements and sample evaluation with ALL KONJAC.
text_346890f38b99: ALL KONJAC provides food-grade konjac ingredients for food manufacturers and international B2B partners. Ingredient enquiries can cover konjac powder, refined konjac powder and konjac gum, with the grade discussed against the intended application.
text_90f898a0bef1: Konjac Powder, Refined Powder & Konjac Gum
text_2ba79f813cac: Discuss the powder grade you need for your food product and production process. A useful enquiry includes the finished product, required specification and intended order quantity.
text_fec07c298e1d: For refined powder enquiries, share the purity and viscosity specification you require. Grade selection should be based on the specification of the proposed material and its performance in your own formulation.
text_3289efe64a02: Konjac gum enquiries can be connected with hydrocolloid formulation and application development. Tell us the texture, water-holding or stability requirement your product needs to meet.
text_b81fb7d031af: Finished food product and intended use.
text_5f557e2b73da: Required purity, viscosity and any other specification, including test methods where applicable.
text_88b7aee1662b: Current formulation and processing conditions you can share.
text_02e942df5890: Sample or commercial quantity, packing requirements and destination market.
text_a058ce803680: Documents required by your purchasing and quality teams.
text_267c19ac798f: Ask for the specification and documentation applicable to the proposed grade before placing an order. Qualification requirements depend on the ingredient, application and destination market.
text_b76d448bba08: If the material needs to be evaluated in a food formulation, discuss an application-development brief alongside the ingredient enquiry. This keeps ingredient selection connected to the finished product and its production process.
text_511fc9ecb67f: Which konjac ingredients can I enquire about?
text_c14f2a7b8b6e: You can enquire about food-grade konjac powder, refined konjac powder and konjac gum. Share your finished product and specification requirements so the discussion can focus on the appropriate grade.
text_62adae69d299: How should I compare ingredient grades?
text_2277d5805207: Compare the proposed specifications, including purity and viscosity with their test methods, and evaluate a sample in your intended formulation and process. Request the documents relevant to the proposed grade.
text_f35155a384d2: What should I send for a quotation?
text_828de126f41f: Send the ingredient or application, required specification, quantity, packing requirements and destination market. If you need application development, include the texture or processing issue you want to address.
text_f06c581f20ad: Connect ingredient selection, formulation development and equipment planning around your production requirements.
text_693edbc8fc7d: Share your application, ingredient requirements or production-line brief so we can discuss the appropriate scope.
text_8c4e2bc2850e: Konjac Food Equipment & Production Lines | ALL KONJAC
text_2c567d898da1: Discuss konjac food equipment, process planning and production-line integration, including equipment design, installation, commissioning and training.
text_a3e103ea1d7e: ALL KONJAC connects konjac food equipment with process planning and production-line integration. The project discussion covers the finished product, factory conditions and the equipment and engineering scope needed for production.
text_ea8a091b8585: Plan the line around the food product
text_682b61f2e442: A konjac food project may involve mixing and slurry preparation, forming, cooking, cooling, cutting, conveying and packaging interfaces. The sequence and equipment scope should be discussed against the actual product and production method.
text_8ca3d5c6161f: Enquiries can cover equipment design, manufacturing and coordination of equipment from external suppliers. Define which machines are required and which interfaces need to connect with the existing factory.
text_4415e5317ce6: Discuss process planning and equipment integration together. A production-line brief should explain how material moves between stages and how the proposed equipment will connect to the rest of the operation.
text_cf31772b39a3: Coordination of packaging and automation interfaces.
text_465e10cc86ff: Confirm which services and equipment are included in the quotation. Capacity, utilities, layout and control requirements need project-specific agreement.
text_243cc44cf6a5: Share the product type, target output, process steps, factory layout and available utilities. Explain whether this is a new line, an expansion or an upgrade, and identify equipment that must be retained.
text_8a6490f26654: Can I discuss an individual machine or a complete line?
text_c3bda01f2f5f: Enquiries can cover individual konjac food machines or production-line integration. Specify the process stages needed and how the equipment should connect to your current or planned factory.
text_5ff3aa377268: What information is needed for equipment planning?
text_02e60dcbff15: Share the finished product, target output, required process stages, available space and utilities. Include existing equipment and installation constraints where relevant.
text_e81060e8103d: Does the engineering scope include installation and training?
text_7a8f344b5b5c: Installation, commissioning and training are service capabilities. Confirm their inclusion, responsibilities and scope in your project quotation before ordering.
text_3ffeb087373e: Konjac Dried-Chip Drying Lines & Systems | ALL KONJAC
text_cd9b1e437b3b: Explore integrated konjac dried-chip drying systems, conveying, air handling and engineering support. Prepare a project brief for ALL KONJAC.
text_53e496662de1: ALL KONJAC provides integrated drying-line solutions for konjac dried-chip processing. A line project brings together material preparation, conveying, drying equipment, air handling and process integration.
text_2be07564a970: Konjac drying-line enquiries can cover washing, slicing, conveying and drying stages. Temperature and humidity control, monitoring and the interfaces between equipment should be considered as part of the process brief.
text_835a4739b237: Project planning connects the drying chambers with conveying equipment, air-handling systems and drives. Define the material flow and the preparation and handling stages needed around the dryer.
text_7c67cf3ade1b: The equipment photographs on this website show a real industrial drying environment, including conveying, drying equipment and air-handling components. Use them as a starting point for discussing layout and engineering scope.
text_900791471334: Incoming material, slice dimensions and starting moisture specification.
text_df68d7130411: Target dried-chip moisture and product requirements.
text_322fcfafe168: Expected input or output quantity and operating schedule.
text_da22de57e3cd: Available building space, utilities and energy source.
text_4843a8d51cc8: Upstream preparation and downstream handling requirements.
text_51365270b4c9: Performance targets and utility requirements are project-specific. Confirm output, operating conditions and any energy targets in the technical proposal.
text_afe4727a1fc1: Discuss line design and equipment integration together with installation and commissioning support. The proposal should identify the machines, interfaces and start-up responsibilities included in the project.
text_c91d8d19af84: Konjac drying equipment installed in an industrial production environment
text_2a39ef134d29: What does a konjac drying-line project cover?
text_0005c6c78366: Depending on the project brief, the discussion can cover preparation, conveying, drying equipment, air handling, process control and line integration. Confirm the actual supply and engineering scope in the proposal.
text_852c7f5651e1: How is the required dryer capacity determined?
text_3463948f5708: Start with the incoming material specification, moisture requirements, expected input or output quantity and operating schedule. These project inputs need to be reviewed before equipment capacity is agreed.
text_cab5880c42dc: Can I see real drying equipment photos?
text_baa7d374ba60: Yes. This page and the homepage show industrial project photographs of drying equipment and production environments. Contact ALL KONJAC to discuss your layout and equipment requirements.
text_8d12e31b4adb: Konjac Hydrocolloid & Formulation Solutions | ALL KONJAC
text_02cc86591dc2: Discuss konjac hydrocolloid solutions, formulation development, application testing and sample development for texture, water holding and stability.
text_523084358cca: ALL KONJAC offers konjac application-development and hydrocolloid formulation support for food manufacturers and international partners. Development discussions begin with the finished product, processing conditions and the performance objective.
text_46b45f4091e5: A development brief can address thickening, gel formation, texture, water holding or stability. Describe the issue in the actual food product rather than specifying an ingredient combination before the application has been reviewed.
text_608501f64093: Discuss the current formulation, ingredient constraints and desired result. The development scope can connect konjac ingredients with the product and the manufacturing method.
text_ee863d8814f2: Application work can include testing and sample development against the agreed product brief. Define how the samples will be assessed, including the handling, processing and storage conditions relevant to your project.
text_a5c5a32597e7: Current texture, water-holding or stability issue.
text_b44b4b0c8029: Target result, sample needs and evaluation criteria.
text_0e4bc2f5b691: Project-specific formulation details and performance outcomes need evaluation. Share the information appropriate for an initial discussion and agree the development scope before proceeding.
text_69bc74b9d48a: Formulation work can be discussed alongside ingredient selection, equipment planning and production-line integration. This helps connect the sample-development brief with the conditions in the factory.
text_ecdfff0fb5d1: What can a hydrocolloid development brief address?
text_bbbfe474bc88: A brief can address thickening, gel formation, texture improvement, water holding or stability. Include the food product and processing conditions so the requirement can be reviewed in context.
text_4d8e69866112: Is there one formulation for every konjac food product?
text_371cf27cf461: Formulation requirements depend on the food product, ingredients, process and target performance. Discuss and evaluate a project-specific solution rather than assuming one formulation suits every application.
text_162e3a83709b: What information is useful before sample development?
text_c621f85d098b: Share the application, current issue, processing conditions, ingredient constraints and evaluation criteria. Agree the target outcome and development scope before sample work begins.
